purpose: Read-only historical decimal-weight audit; no Production mutation
query: WITH sources AS (SELECT 'recommendation_previews' AS source, input AS value FROM recommendation_previews UNION ALL SELECT 'guest_drafts', input FROM guest_drafts), weights AS (SELECT source,sources.value->>'contractVersion' AS version, m->'ski'->'weightKg' AS weight FROM sources CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(sources.value->'members','[]'::jsonb)) m), counts AS (SELECT source,count(*) AS profiles,count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(weight)='number' AND (weight::text)::numeric<>trunc((weight::text)::numeric)) AS decimal_profiles FROM weights GROUP BY source) SELECT current_database() AS database,now() AS checked_at,(SELECT count(*) FROM rental_bookings) AS bookings,(SELECT count(*) FROM rental_preparations) AS preparations,(SELECT count(*) FROM recommendation_previews) AS previews,(SELECT count(*) FROM guest_drafts) AS drafts,coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(counts) FROM counts),'[]'::jsonb) AS profile_counts

migrationReadback.query: SELECT count(*) AS migration_count, max(id) AS latest_migration FROM foundation_migrations
